ownership.immutable_history: Each declared local replica version or TP head-shard owner
ownership.private_append: Branch owner with an exclusive row lease
ownership.verification: Declared target verifier on the accepted conditional prefix
ownership.winner: Only the lineage/interval allowed by target verification, not a confidence winner
ownership.commit: Publish an epoch after the required payload and metadata complete on that receiver
ownership.rollback: Discard losing private suffixes after readers finish. Retain borrowed prefixes until all references finish.
ownership.future_lane_dependency: Send matching tentative ancestor depth KV before the dependent attention read. A replicated committed prefix does not contain those new tentative states.

messages.precondition: Correct parent lineage and input IDs exist.
Source version is committed. Receiver completes placement before reading.
Actual ancestor depth/layer state exists. No stale or other-lineage substitution.
Target evaluation uses the accepted conditional prefix.
Only accepted input positions and valid target state can publish.
Payload/metadata completion. Reader leases can still delay release.
No remaining readers or descendants of the released private rows.

formulas.wire_lower_bound_scope: Declared uncompressed BF16 representation, one initial copy per state item, no receiver recomputation. Adaptive terminal-copy deduplication is separately declared.
formulas.B: 2*L*16*128*2 bytes per cached input position/pass across all physical layers
formulas.K: 4*B bytes per cached full-depth input position
formulas.valid_private_state: B*U, U counts unique computed token/pass states after prefix deduplication
formulas.expanded_private_capacity: K*F, F counts private input positions in the expanded four-slot layout
formulas.initial_fixed_replication_wire: (P-1)*K*N, assuming one initial state copy and no recomputation
formulas.fixed_accepted_commit_wire: (P-1)*K*k, k counts newly cached accepted input positions
formulas.adaptive_wire_history: B*(4*N_prompt+sum_decode D(t)), with known completed terminal depths and local copy reconstruction
formulas.missing_version_delivery: Sum payload_bytes(state) once for every receiver lacking that exact version
formulas.no_double_count: Tentative accepted-state deliveries count toward later commit replication. Losing-lineage deliveries remain extra.
formulas.TP_fixed_weight_payload: W/P+(norm_bytes+2)*(1-1/P), ideal unpadded linear sharding with replicated norms and native gate bias
formulas.TP_adaptive_weight_payload: W/P+(norm_bytes+gate_bytes)*(1-1/P), one possible ideal layout with replicated original gate
formulas.capacity_example: C=1,N=8192,J=P,k=4 private full-depth input positions per branch. Replica rank=W+K*N+k*K. TP rank=TP_weight+K*N/P+k*K.

sampling_costs.condition: A residual sampler needs both required distributions. Co-location avoids transfer. Otherwise send the missing distribution or charge recomputation.
sampling_costs.RNG_contract: Request-local counters and decisions must not change with rank scheduling.

CPU_checks.command_description: Python stdlib binary-header parse plus exact integer payload formulas and symbolic per-receiver state-version accounting
CPU_checks.limitations: No bandwidth, HBM traffic, physical allocation, branch validation, sampler, concurrent rollback, or distributed engine executes.

reopen_condition: Provide a concrete recurrence-specific ownership change that reduces a measured exposed cost beyond TP of the same verified branch batch. Charge initial history, tentative dependencies, rejected work, commit, and state capacity.
